fields.description:
Landed as feat/http-body-cap. Rejects >64KB with 413; toast on the client suggests splitting the note.

R3 testers hit the silent-500 on ~70KB bodies (nginx buffer, NTL finding 2026-08-05). Cap is server-side so nginx buffer isn't the source of truth.

comments.body: Middleware order matters — this has to run after body-parse or the check has nothing to measure. Coordinating with Ava on NTL-142.
Reserving `x-notely-note-too-large: true` for the 413 response so the client can render a nice error instead of a generic toast.
PR #87 up. Tests green. Waiting on middleware pipeline merge to unblock.
